decision.explanation: The question asks for the consul election year of 'Lucius Calpurnius Piso Caesoninus'. The source documents contain two distinct individuals with this name. D1S1, D1S2, D2S1-D2S12, and D3S1-D3S2 explicitly identify a Piso who was consul in 112 BC (son of the 148 BC consul). D4S1-D4S5 explicitly identify a different Piso (grandfather of the one married to Julia) who was consul in 148 BC. Since the prompt allows for distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers, and the sources clearly distinguish between these two figures (one being the son, one the father/grandfather), both years are valid answers corresponding to different entities sharing the same name.
